description: SonicWALL's TZ Series is a network security platform that combines a deep packet inspection firewall, anti-virus, anti-spyware, intrusion prevention, content filtering, 56k modem backup, and 802.11 b/g WLAN, which allow small and branch offices to implement protection against the wide spectrum of emerging network threats.
